entities.name: Vglut2+ glutamatergic neurons in spinal dorsal horn

relationships.subject: CB1R
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings do not support the hypothesis of a direct CB1R-MOR interaction.

relationships.subject: Vglut2+ glutamatergic neurons in PVT
relationships.evidence_quote: Among Vglut2-positive glutamate neurons in the PVT, approximately 12% (±3%) expressed Cnr1 only, 14% (±2%) expressed Oprm1 only, and 52% (±5%) co-expressed both Cnr1 and Oprm1

relationships.subject: MOR
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings suggest that selective MOR deletion from either GABA or glutamate neurons does not affect the classical pharmacological effects of cannabinoids.

key_findings: CB1R and MOR show distinct distributions with 5-25% colocalization except ~50% in PVT Vglut2 neurons
Conditional MOR deletion from Vglut2 or Vgat neurons did not alter THC effects, and CB1R deletion from GABA neurons did not alter oxycodone effects
